name: duplex-buyers-atlas
title: VanToVault Duplex Buyers Atlas: Owner-Occupant 2-4 Unit Purchase Loans by Metro, 2018-2025
cite_as: Van to Vault (2026). VanToVault Duplex Buyers Atlas: Owner-Occupant 2-4 Unit Purchase Loans by Metro, 2018-2025 (Version 1.0.1) [Data set]. VanToVault. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23003737
changelog: 1.0.1 (2026-09-27): deposit edition. Title, citation, DOI and creator added to this header. National and metro records unchanged from 1.0.0 (2026-09-17).

source.dataset: Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) public loan-level data
source.source_note: FFIEC HMDA Data Browser API, nationwide CSV, actions_taken=1, total_units=2,3,4; filtered to occupancy_type=1, loan_purpose=1, lien_status=1. Investor count (inv) = same filters with occupancy_type=3. Income in $000s; loan amounts are HMDA public bin midpoints.

investor_comparison_filter.note: investor_loans column uses occupancy_type=3 with otherwise identical filters

suppression.cell_rule: Count cells with 1-9 loans are blank/null.
suppression.metro_rule: Metro-years with fewer than 50 qualifying loans are reported as 3-year totals (the year plus the two prior years available); medians are null on those rows because medians are not additive.
suppression.flag_note: suppressed_core=TRUE means a headline count (total/unit/loan-type) was hidden. suppressed_detail=TRUE means only a demographic, age or LTV detail cell was hidden; this is true for most rows and does not affect the headline counts. suppressed_cells is how many cells were hidden on that row.

known_issues: 14 metro names are duplicated across different CBSA codes (e.g. CLEVELAND 17410 and 17420); cbsa_code is the authoritative key.
cbsa_code 99999 is 'N/A OR OUTSIDE MSA/MD', not a metro. cbsa_code 0 is unclassified (2018-2019 only). Both have is_metro=FALSE.
HMDA splits the largest metros into Metropolitan Divisions; those appear as separate codes.
Metro name spellings and code assignments change across years (OMB delineation updates); do not assume a code is comparable across all 8 years.
limitations: Cash purchases never appear in HMDA.
Lenders below HMDA reporting thresholds do not report.
Occupancy is borrower-stated at application and is not verified.
Loan amounts are HMDA public bin midpoints, so medians are approximate.
This data cannot show approval odds or pricing fairness.
